title: Ejecutivo/a de cuentas y operaciones brazil
description:
Oportunidad profesional Latin Xplore Brasil !
Latin Xplore, agencia receptiva mayorista B2 B y empresa hermana de Go West Tours (DMC USA), que tiene oficinas en Costa Rica, Panama, Colombia, Ecuador, Peru, Argentina, Brazil y Chile esta buscando su Ejecutivo de Cuentas y operaciones en nuestra oficina de Rio, Brasil.
Su misión va desde el establecimiento de itinerarios, la reelaboración de estos dentro de los presupuestos del cliente, la contratación, la facturación y la organización de los grupos y FITs, así como la asistencia en la organización de la A a la Z de los diferentes tours.
Puesto:Ejecutivo de Cuentas y Operaciones
Lugar:Bureau de Latin Xplore à Rio, Brasil
Descripción del Puesto
- Estar en contacto con los Tour Operadores, las agencias de viajes de Europa para responder a los pedidos de viajes y producciones para sus clientes
-Realizar cotizaciones de los viajes y elaboración de producciones
- Negociar con los proveedores para estar competitivos, mejorar las tarifas de compra y las márgenes, con la ayuda del Gerente General
-Desarrollar la facturación de la cartera de clientes: mantenimiento de relaciones con clientes existentes y desarollo con nuevos clientes, fidelizar, mantener el vínculo con las cuentas clave,
-Trabajo comercial con posible participación en ferias, seguimiento de los files, relanzas,
-Coordinación con de las operaciones. Cumplir, cuando sea necesario, con tareas de operación (reservar hoteles, guías, restaurantes, transfers, excursiones).
- Manejar las distintas herramientas de comercialización y trabajo : Travel Exchange, Toursys, Excel
Competencias Técnicas Requeridas:
•Dominio Avanzado de Herramientas Informáticas:Excelente competencia en Microsoft Office, especialmente en Excel para cotizaciones, Word para la redacción de documentos. Canva sería una ventaja.
• Experiencia Profesional en Turismo:Experiencia significativa en una agencia de viajes o en una agencia receptiva, con una comprensión profunda de las operaciones y la logística del turismo, así como del mercado B2 B.
•Conocimiento del Terreno de Brasil :Un conocimiento profundo de los principales destinos turísticos, las regulaciones locales y las particularidades culturales, lo cual es esencial para la elaboración de propuestas de viaje a medida. El conocimiento de otros países como Argentina puede ser también una ventaja.
Competencias sociales y personales:
• Flexibilidad y adaptabilidad:Capacidad para adaptarse rápidamente a los cambios y gestionar eficazmente situaciones imprevistas, entusiasmo e inversión en una empresa en pleno crecimiento que coloca al ser humano en el centro de sus preocupaciones.
• Multitarea y gestión de la presión:Capacidad para gestionar simultáneamente varios proyectos y clientes mientras se cumplen plazos ajustados, garantizando una prestación de servicio eficiente y profesional.
• Competencias interpersonales y comunicación:Excelente habilidad para comunicarse, negociar y establecer relaciones duraderas con clientes y proveedores.
• Orientación al cliente:Compromiso para proporcionar un servicio al cliente excepcional, anticipar las necesidades de los clientes y proponer soluciones creativas y adaptadas. Rigor y sentido del detalle son cualidades que buscamos para estar lo más alineados posible con las especificaciones de nuestros clientes y nuestra carta de calidad.
Lo que ofrecemos:
•Un salario competitivo basado en la experiencia•Contrato local con beneficios complementarios•Entorno de trabajo híbrido, combinando oficina y teletrabajo•Participación en un proyecto innovador y en plena expansión, con un excelente ambiente de trabajo y posibilidades de crecimiento
Para presentar su candidatura, envíe su CV y una carta de presentación a , especificando en qué medida su experiencia y aptitudes se ajustan a los requisitos de este puesto. Esperamos darle la bienvenida a nuestro equipo y hacer de nuestra colaboración un éxito conjunto.

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!AIdioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online:você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco.Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*O que oferecemos?Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
Acesso exclusivo auma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeosde treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis,com vídeos totalmente atualizados.
Mentorias semanaiscom especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
Plataformaexclusivapara acompanhamento das aulas.
Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.Necessário:Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanaispara treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.O diferencial?Aqui você é mais que um professor.Você será parte deuma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.Estanão é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, aiicom certeza é o seu lugar.Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas.Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!O que eu faço?Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/asSe você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.Seja diferente, seja independente

title: College-level chemistry tutor
description:
We are looking for tutors to solve college-level Chemistry questions in English. These questions are submitted by students, who expect a response in less than 24 hours.Tutors in this project work in freelance mode and can decide the number of hours they wish to work.Do you prefer to work in the morning, in the evening, for a few hours or many hours? The choice is yours. You can log in at any time to help students. In addition, you can work from anywhere, as long as you have a computer with a reliable Internet connection.We need tutors who can start immediately!CharacteristicsPayment in dollars.
Type of contract: freelance/self-employed.
Schedule: Flexible, free choice
Start: Immediate
Duration: IndefiniteRequirementsAbility to solve university-level questions in at least one of the following subjects:
General Chemistry
Organic Chemistry
Student or graduate of a university course whose curriculum includes at least one of the subjects listed in the previous point.
Computer with an Internet connection.
No criminal record.About Latin HireFounded in 2003, Latin Hire is a company specialising in managing teams of experts for distance learning institutions. Its clients include some of the world's most prestigious education startups.

title: Sap fiori
description:

title: Programador ruby
description:
Descrição da Empresa:Oni Learning Technology é uma edtech brasileira cujo objetivo é melhorar a aprendizagem, permitindo que pessoas organizem e criem seu próprio conteúdo educacional. Utilizamos aplicativos móveis que facilitam o processo de aprendizagem, envolvendo professores, alunos e escolas, do ensino fundamental ao ensino superior. Para alunos, Oni Learning funciona como um caderno digital inteligente e interativo, enquanto para professores oferece a criação de material didático personalizado. As instituições educacionais economizam custos e aprimoram a qualidade da educação com o uso de Oni Learning. Juntem-se a nós nessa revolução educacional!Descrição do Cargo:Estamos buscando um Programador Ruby para integrar nossa equipe. Este cargo envolve desenvolver, manter e melhorar nossas aplicações Ruby, colaborando com outros desenvolvedores e equipes de produto para entregar soluções de alta qualidade. O profissional será responsável por garantir a performance e a escalabilidade dos sistemas, além de implementar novas funcionalidades e corrigir bugs. Este é um cargo de tempo integral e remoto.Qualificações:
Desenvolvimento em Ruby:Necessário experiência em programação com Ruby e Ruby on Rails, desenvolvimento de aplicativos web e APIs.
Design de Software:Habilidades em design de software, práticas de codificação limpa e arquitetura de sistemas.
Controle de Versão:Familiaridade com ferramentas de controle de versão, como Git, para gerenciar e compartilhar código.
Trabalho em Equipe:Capacidade de colaborar efetivamente com equipes multifuncionais, habilidades de comunicação e resolução de problemas.
Serão considerados diferenciais conhecimentos em outras linguagens de programação, experiência em metodologias ágeis e formação na área de Tecnologia da Informação ou afins.Interessado? Envie seu currículo diretamente ao nosso head: Paulo Afonso C. Arruda, pelo e-mail: ONIlearning Technology agradece antecipadamente o seu interesse em fazer parte de nosso time de campeões!Paulo Afonso Cardoso de Arruda
Head de Operações e Tecnologia
ONIlearning Technology

title: Sap technical cutover manager
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.We are looking forSAP Technical Cutover Managerwho wants to learn and transform his career.In this role you will: (responsibilities)'Key Responsibilities
Co-lead end-to-end SAP technical activities with K-C leadership and PMO to guide the project team’s efforts to successfully go-live with localization and deployment of a previously built greenfield global template of SAP S/4 HANA in the RISE private cloud in MS Azure to K-C business segments in Asia.• Lead and coordinate technical SAP localization and deployment tasks throughout the life of the project including technical landscape readiness, completion of remaining SAP build configuration and development activities and completion of technical activities to localize SAP S/4 HANA according to regional requirements in Asia.• Collaborate with K-C leadership, project managers, functional leads, technical platform leads, SAP developers, and business stakeholders to complete all technical activities in a pre-planned and pre-defined sequence to ensure alignment with project goals, milestones and specific deliverables.• Manage and document traceability between technical requirements, business requirements, completion of deliverables that meet requirements, testing activities and defect resolution through go-live and into hypercare.• Provide leadership and mentorship to other cutover business and technical team members and adhere to SAP S/4 HANA cutover best practices and standards.
Track and report technical cutover preparation and progress, risks, actions, issues and decisions to project leadership through the Microsoft Asure Dev Ops (ADO) project management tool, meetings, emails and project documents.Required Qualifications
5+ years of experience in SAP technical cutover management, with at least 5 years in a technical cutover or related technical leadership role.
Strong understanding of SAP modules (e.g., FI/CO, MM, SD, PP, WM, BW and more) and their integration points.
Prior hands-on experience with SAP configuration, development, implementation troubleshooting and resolution of technical defects is required for this Technical Cutover Manager to manage all technical activities of other technical cutover resources.
Excellent communication, coordination, and stakeholder management skills.
Strong critical thinking and problem-solving abilities.Preferred Skills
Experience with prior projects with a successful cutover to go-live with SAP S/4 HANA.
Familiarity with Agile and hybrid waterfall and Agile project methodologies.What can you expect from us?• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

description:

Aqui, a diversidade, a igualdade e a inclusão estão no centro e garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro para todas as pessoas faz parte de quem somos.
Promovemos uma cultura de desenvolvimento e crescimento pautadas no nosso pilar de Continuous Scaled Learning porque acreditamos o uso inteligente da tecnologia é a chave para o sucesso nesse mundo digital.O que estamos buscando?Engenharia de Dados AWS Sênior - ID Requisitos:
Responsabilidades: Desenvolver e manter aplicações complexas em Python, com foco em performance, escalabilidade e segurança. Contribuir com a arquitetura e design de sistemas de grande porte, visando soluções robustas e eficientes. Colaborar ativamente em todas as fases do desenvolvimento de software, desde a concepção até a implementação e manutenção. Mentorizar e compartilhar conhecimentos com desenvolvedores mais juniores, contribuindo para o crescimento do time. Implementar testes automatizados (unitários e integrados), garantindo a qualidade do código. Trabalhar com integração contínua e pipelines de Dev Ops, promovendo a automação de processos. Participar de code reviews, propondo melhorias e boas práticas de desenvolvimento. Manter-se atualizado com novas tecnologias e práticas do mercado, trazendo inovações para os projetos. Requisitos: Experiência sólida de 5+ anos com desenvolvimento em Python. Profundo conhecimento de frameworks como Django, Flask, Fast API ou similares. Experiência em integração de APIs RESTful, microserviços e sistemas distribuídos. Sólidos conhecimentos de bancos de dados relacionais (Postgre SQL, My SQL) e No SQL (Mongo DB, Redis). Experiência com testes automatizados (pytest, unittest) e ferramentas de integração contínua (Jenkins, Git Lab CI). Experiência em ambientes de cloud computing, como AWS, Google Cloud ou Azure. Conhecimento de práticas de segurança em desenvolvimento de software. Familiaridade com containerização (Docker) e orquestração (Kubernetes). Habilidade de trabalhar em equipe e boa comunicação para interagir com áreas multidisciplinares. Capacidade de analisar e resolver problemas complexos de forma eficiente.Descrição comportamental:
Procuramos uma pessoa que:
Goste de trabalhar em equipe e sejacolaborativaem suas atribuições;

title: Senior backend (typescript) engineer
description:
Would you like to partake in technical challenges and contribute to taking our product to market? Are you ready to meet and exceed ambitious targets in a rapid-paced, results-driven startup environment? Then keep reading!Yes, tell me more…
fullinfo is a startup B2 B data services software company.
We are building an un-paralleled data collection pipeline which is being deployed on AWS and written in Go and Typescript. With a focus on innovation, quality, and accessibility, we are developing a one-stop lead generator platform.
The Customer facing part of the solution is a Typescript and Graph QL based web application. Deployed on AWS as well. Serverless paradigm is being applied: Most of our code is running as AWS’s Lambda’s. AWS infrastructure is managed by applying Terraform.We’re looking for aSenior Backend (Typescript) Engineerto join on an initial 12-month B2 B contract basis. The ideal candidate will be comfortable with AWS (Serverless architecture), Typescript and willing to pick up new technologies such as Go. A language agnostic attitude towards software engineering is considered as a pro.Responsibilities:
You are responsible for the quality of our data processing pipeline
Creating and reviewing processes that affect speed and cost efficiency
Ensuring all steps in our data pipeline are integrated seamlessly
Optimising the product for continuous scalability
Delivering ongoing process improvement
Collaborate with frontend engineers, CTO and principle software engineer
Meet aggressive development timelines.
Own complex tasks from concept to completion, ensuring the highest standards of quality under pressure.Requirements:
A Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or related field
A minimum of 5 years relevant experience working in Backend Software Engineering
Experience using Typescript for Backend Development
Experience with other programming languages like Python, Java, C++
Business Proficiency in English is essential
Meticulous attention to detail.
Proven ability to thrive in a high-pressure, deadline-driven environment.
Startup mentality – understands the dedication it takes to thrive in a startup environment.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Business-level English required.
A strong history of delivering high-quality, high-impact results with minimal supervision.The successful candidate will…
Be comfortable working with the frontend if required
Have a desire to work on different features within our solution, and take a generalist role
Possess the ability to familiarize yourself with our product quickly to generate new ideas, reflect on our existing features and think ahead
Be experienced with or passionate about guiding other developers
Take on a proactive, hands-on approach
Be a proactive, results-oriented professional who excels when challenged.What can you expect from us?
To shape the company from the ground up – join our team as a pioneer and help us carve our way forward. This means taking on significant ownership and being accountable for delivering high-impact results quickly.
Together we’ll take our product to market –how cool would it be to celebrate together as part of our highly motivated team?
A startup environment that is passionate about quality, problem solving and building beautiful software. Be prepared for a very fast-paced environment where priorities can shift quickly to meet market and business demands.Our passion stems from our shared values and mission. With that said, our culture is built on two major aspects:
Quality :At fullinfo we let the quality of our product speak for itself. We are passionate about building beautiful software and always raising the bar on quality.
Problem Solving :We foster innovation and novel approaches to problem solving, while keeping user needs at front of mind.

title: Software engineer sênior - vaga afirmativa para pessoas lgbtqiapn+
description:
A abertura atual é para a Artefact do Brasil, mas estamos em modelo Free Office.Quem nós somos
Nós da Artefact Brasil acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!
Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.
Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.
Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact !Quais serão suas atividades;Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias.
Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes. Além de desenvolver, você será referência técnica, ajudando a definir padrões e boas práticas dentro da equipe.Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:
Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicações webutilizandoJava Script/Type Scripte frameworks modernos comoReact e Next.js , priorizando arquitetura limpa, reuso e performance.
Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dadoscom bancos relacionais e não relacionais(Postgre SQL, Mongo DB, Azure Cosmos DB) , com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.
Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem , configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, comoAzure, GCP e AWS.
Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar :transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos.
Definir arquitetura de softwaree padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas deDev Ops, CI/CD , testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
Mentorar desenvolvedoresde diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.
Contribuir estrategicamentepara decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções.O que nós estamos procurando;Formação:Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.
Experiência solida (+5 anos):em desenvolvimento web comReact, Next.js, Java Script e Type Script.
Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e No SQL , com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.
Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) , incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
Experiência prática com Dev Ops e CI/CD , uso deDocker ,Kubernetese ferramentas de integração contínua.
Visão arquiteturale capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas.
Inglês fluente(para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais).O que oferecemos;
VR/VT
Free office(trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)
Gympass
Seguros:Vida, saúde e odontológico
Encontros Bimestrais(Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!)
Woba(pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)
Avaliações semestrais(com oportunidade de promoção)Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;
Artefacté o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados
Progresso:cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender
Cultura:junte-se à melhor equipe que você poderia imaginar
Empreendedorismo:você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!
Junte-se a nós!

description:

Se você busca desafios técnicos, quer trabalhar com produtos digitais de alta escala e participar da construção de uma solução proprietária inovadora essa parceria é para você.Responsabilidades

Colaborar com times multidisciplinares de UX, backend, dados e produto, em um ambiente de desenvolvimento ágil.

title: Anti-money laundering manager
description:
About Us
Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.Key Responsibilities:
Implement and maintain AML/CFT and sanctions policies and procedures aligned with Brazilian regulatory requirements and global best practices.
Regulatory interface (inspections, responses, remediation plans)
Conduct customer due diligence (CDD/KYC/KYB) and enhanced due diligence (EDD) reviews in accordance with risk-based methodologies.
Support ongoing transaction monitoring, screening, and investigation of suspicious activities.
Prepare, review, and file Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) and other regulatory filings withCOAFor relevant authorities.
Monitor developments in AML/CFT and sanctions laws, and assist in updating internal procedures accordingly.
Assist in the delivery of internal training and awareness sessions on AML/CFT and sanctions compliance.
Conduct periodic risk assessments, ensuring all controls are operating effectively and aligned with the company’s enterprise risk management framework.
Maintain accurate documentation and audit trails for all compliance reviews, escalations, and filings.
Support internal and external audits, as well as inspections or information requests from regulators.
Coordinate with Legal, Risk, Operations, and Technology teams to strengthen compliance systems and data integrity.
Contribute to the assessment and oversight of third-party vendors that support AML/CFT and compliance operations.Requirements:
Legally resident in Brazil.
Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in AML/CFT and sanctions compliance experience in financial, fintech, or VASP sectors.
Proven ability to operate independently as part of the second line of defense.
Strong understanding of COAF, Central Bank of Brazil, and CVM regulations, as well as FATF standards.
Proficient in KYC/KYB, transaction monitoring, and suspicious activity reporting.
Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Economics, or related field; postgraduate or certification (e.g., CAMS, ICA) preferred.
Excellent analytical skills, professional integrity, and fluency in Portuguese and English.
Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors, including:
not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
unblemished reputation;
knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.

title: Api engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.We are looking forAPI Designer/Engineerwho wants to learn and transform his career.In this role you will: (responsibilities)Overview
The API Designer/Engineer is a pivotal role responsible for implementing API Design First principles to create scalable, secure, and consumer-centric APIs. The candidate will focus on designing API specifications and frameworks that ensure seamless developer experiences while meeting Customer's API standards and architectural guidelines.Key Responsibilities
API Design & Development
Adopt an API Design First Approach : Leverage Open API (Swagger), RAML, or Async API specifications to define APIs before implementation, ensuring clarity and alignment across stakeholders.
API Specification Creation : Design API specifications that adhere to Customer's API standards, covering endpoints, data structures, error handling, and response codes.
Policy Design and Configuration : Define and configure API policies (security, routing, transformation, throttling, etc.) using tools such as Azure API Management (APIM).
Mock API Development : Create mock APIs for early-stage validation and testing to facilitate integration and feedback before development.
API Testing : Perform unit testing of API specifications to ensure functionality, reliability, and adherence to defined standards.
Environment Configuration : Configure API backend settings within APIM (naming conventions, App Insights, Key Vault) in DEV, UAT, and PRD environments.
API Deployment : Deploy draft APIs into the Azure APIM Dev instance and promote them across DEV, UAT, and PRD environments using the API Dev Ops framework.
Documentation : Create comprehensive API documentation, including references, developer guides, and examples, in line with Customer's standards.
Metadata Publishing : Publish API Identity Cards (metadata, usage information) to the Azure API Management Developer Portal to enable easy discovery and adoption by consumers.API Consumer Onboarding
Secure Authentication Setup : Configure OAuth/Open ID Connect to ensure secure authentication and authorization for API consumers.
Subscription Key Management : Share API subscription keys securely with consumers and maintain robust tracking mechanisms.
Integration Testing Support : Collaborate with API consumers during integration testing to resolve issues and provide guidance on proper usage.Testing & Validation
Functional Testing : Conduct and support API functional, integration, and performance testing to validate API readiness and scalability.
Mock and Staging Environment Management : Ensure availability of mock services and staging environments for API testing and feedback gathering.Skills and Expertise
API Design First Expertise : Proficient in designing APIs using Open API, Swagger Hub, or similar tools with a focus on consumer-first design principles.
Azure API Management : Deep experience in configuring and managing APIs using Azure API Management.
Security Standards : Strong knowledge of OAuth2, Open ID Connect, and API key management best practices.
Documentation Excellence : Skilled in creating developer-friendly documentation and API identity cards.
Testing Proficiency : Familiarity with API testing frameworks and methodologies to validate functionality and performance. Proficient in using Postman toolWhat can you expect from us?• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

title: Principal ai engineer - ai in healthcare
description:
WHO WE AREWe are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:
Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care
Automated coding and billing optimization
Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials
Seamless compliance with value-based care requirementsJoin us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOUThis is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.KEY RESPONSIBILITIESVery hands-on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!1. Build and Refine AI Products
Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers
Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy
Use AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy
Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough
Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products
Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy3. Own the Development Lifecycle
Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production
Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement
Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process
Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space
In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge baseREQUIRED EXPERTISE1. Technical Skills
Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go
Hands-on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)
Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, Open AI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)
Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency
Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications
Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (Postgre SQL)2. Mindset & Approach
Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment
Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly
A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team
Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing3. Highly Valued Qualifications
Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, Git Hub Copilot, or similar
Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change
Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures
Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (Lang Chain, Llama Index, or similar)
Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle managementHealthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We'll teach you what you need to know.WHAT WE OFFER1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity
Ground-floor opportunity in a stealth-mode company with massive market potential
Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions
Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale2. Professional Excellence
Work alongside world-class engineers and healthcare industry veterans
Access to cutting-edge LLM technologies solving complex, real-world problems
Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure
Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside3. Work-Life Integration
Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones
Fast-paced environment where you'll learn constantly and be challenged daily
Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients
Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainabilityREADY FOR THE CHALLENGE?If you're a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.

title: Operations manager
description:
Fulkrum is a global leader in inspection, expediting, auditing, and technical staffing services, delivering exceptional solutions to the energy, engineering, and construction industries for over 14 years. Headquartered in the UK, we have established a strong presence across six continents, serving more than 300 clients worldwide.
Our commitment to excellence has been recognised with prestigious awards, including the King's Award for Enterprise in International Trade (2023), the People and Competency Award at the EIC Awards (2023), and the Scale-Up Award at the WESCA North America Awards (2024). Most recently, Fulkrum was named the 2025 winner in the People, Culture & Optimisation category at the EIC North & Central America Regional Awards.Our Brazil Office is currently seeking a highly motivated and experienced Operations Manager to join our dynamic team.Main Responsibilities (include but are not limited to):
Operational Leadership
Efficiency and Compliance: Guide the team in operational excellence through regular training and adherence to work instructions, ensuring timely responses, accurate reporting, and proper use of the IRIS system, Integrated Management System, and all company policies, processes, and procedures. Overall responsibility for leadership and support, which enables the team and Region to meet and surpass KPIs and Quality Metrics.
Training and Development: Conduct initial and ongoing training for QC Coordinators (QCCs), maintaining minimal errors and supporting development. Ensure the gap analysis assessment is completed for all new starters and, as needed, for experienced coordinators.
IRIS Compliance: Oversee IRIS accuracy and compliance for the Region, ensuring client and inspector profiles, rates, assignments, and reports are up-to-date and meet Fulkrum standards. Operations Managers should become “super-users” of IRIS, driving continuous improvements throughout the team and the business.
Financial Oversight: Improve cash flow and reduce the Cash Conversion Cycle (CCC) by supporting Accounts and managing invoicing challenges between departments, reducing errors and minimising un-invoiced visits, ensuring POs and approvals are received on time, supporting credit control escalations, and reporting issues promptly and consistently to Senior Management. Identify areas for improvement between coordination and accounts, suggest process improvements, draft Corrective Action Reports (CARs), and support cash flow and credit control objectives.
Budget Management: Support the Regional Manager in budget maintenance, report on client activity levels, and drive financial efficiencies. Monitor and manage office expenses and personnel utilisation. Recommend improvements to the Regional Manager.
Gross Profit Targets: Ensure gross profit objectives by overseeing client and inspector negotiations, minimising reliance on agencies, and upholding service standards.
Growth and Client Engagement: Collaborate with Sales to highlight Fulkrum’s capabilities and successes, recommend growth opportunities, and support the acquisition of new clients and service lines. Present IRIS and Fulkrum’s strengths in client meetings to support business development.
Client Retention: Schedule reviews with key clients, addressing service quality and identifying any gaps for improvement. Maintain client relationships through regular communication and promptly address any issues to ensure satisfaction. Report concerns to the Regional Manager as needed.
CRM and Reporting: Document client interactions in Salesforce, compile monthly reports, and highlight successes, challenges, and key client insights for the Regional Manager.
Overhead Management: Regularly assess team workloads to maintain operational efficiencies, minimise redundancies, and support overhead budget goals. Propose staffing adjustments to the Regional Manager as required.Team Development
Recruitment and Onboarding: Collaborate with HR to recruit and onboard new team members, ensuring resources and support are ready for a smooth start.
Performance and Probation Management: Lead 30-, 60-, and 90-day reviews for new hires, ensuring development aligns with company standards. Conduct regular performance evaluations and address skill gaps through targeted training.Compliance & QHSE
Process Optimisation: Act as a “process expert” within Fulkrum, supporting the Integrated Management System (IMS) and continuous process improvements. Collaborate on IRIS developments and provide training for each improvement.
Focal Point: for QHSE and Compliance during internal/external audits, draft and implement CARs as necessary, support all IMS initiatives for process improvements.Commercial
Proposal and Contract Support: Support bid preparation, draft project-specific execution plans and procedures, create/approve rate sheets, perform contract renewals, and support all other commercial requirements as needed.
Insurance and Compliance: Coordinate insurance documents, bank letters, and tax documentation, ensuring sufficient coverage for client projects.Team Culture and Engagement
Team Building: Foster a positive and inclusive office culture, organising team events and maintaining a supportive environment. Promote retention through effective leadership and engagement initiatives.
Engagement: Drive any engagement survey initiatives and follow up on global, regional and local actions to ensure continuous engagement of the team.Client Account Management
Client Service Reviews: Schedule meetings with key clients to evaluate service quality and implement corrective actions as necessary.
Business Development Support: Assist the Regional Manager and Key Account Managers in bidding, negotiating contracts, presenting to prospective clients, and identifying new business opportunities.
Growth and Forecasting: Monitor project forecasts, ensure proper onboarding of new clients, and communicate budget impacts to the Regional Manager and Finance Department.Coordination Responsibilities
Client Support: Manage client requests for QA/QC, Engineering, and Project Support, ensuring prompt and accurate fulfilment.
Candidate Management: Source candidates, prepare them for interviews, and coordinate their placement, handling contractual and performance-related concerns throughout their assignments.
Service Level Agreements: Ensure adherence to all client SLAs and Fulkrum KPIs, negotiating inspector rates to support office margins.Qualifications and Skills
Minimum 10 years of industry experience, with 5 years in a leadership role.
Extensive knowledge of oil and gas projects, both onshore and offshore.
Proficient in MS Office; CRM experience preferred.
Demonstrated client relationship management skills, with the ability to thrive in fast-paced environments.Personal Attributes
Highly organised, process-oriented, and capable of multitasking.
Strong leadership skills with a proven ability to motivate and guide teams.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Willingness to support personnel and clients outside of standard hours as necessary.Additional Information:
This is a pivotal role within the organisation, requiring exceptional interpersonal skills, keen attention to detail, and a comprehensive understanding of the oil and gas industry. The ideal candidate will be a strong team leader who consistently delivers the highest standards of service to clients. Candidates with a background in the coordination or management of large projects, a thorough knowledge of Fulkrum’s coordination and accounts processes, and a proven ability to build and nurture client relationships will excel in this position. This individual will inspire their team to meet and exceed company goals, driving both performance and growth.Travel
Travel will frequently be required throughout the Region.HSE Awareness:
All personnel are informed of Fulkrum’s Health and Safety policy and procedures during the onboarding process. Any HSE incidents must be reported and logged with the QHSE Manager, who will oversee and support any subsequent investigations.Why Join Us?
This is an exciting opportunity for a driven Operations Manager to showcase their expertise in a supportive and collaborative environment. At Fulkrum, you’ll make a tangible impact while advancing your career in the thriving global business sector.We offer a fantastic working environment with a highly engaged team and consistently high e NPS scores. Fulkrum's success in attracting new clients and expanding our global footprint is a testament to our excellence and dedication. We have regular reward and recognition initiatives, a social budget, and a refer-a-friend scheme to ensure our team feels valued and motivated.Join us to be part of a high-performing team with ample opportunities for skill enhancement and development. Be a part of our success story and contribute to our continued growth and innovation.Apply nowand become a valued part of our growing team!Fulkrum

The Opportunity
Grass Valley’s FPGA Engineers develop state-of-the -art solutions for content creation, transmission, and distribution. We are dedicated to redefining the way audiences experience entertainment and information through cutting-edge technology. We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced FPGA Engineer specializing in Broadcast Video and Audio to join our team. As a FPGA Engineer, you will be instrumental in the design, development, testing and implementation of FPGA-based solutions specifically tailored for broadcast video and audio applications. Your responsibilities will encompass leading FPGA architecture design, electronic and PCB design and collaborating with cross-functional teams to integrate these solutions into our broadcast systems.Your Role
Lead the architecture, design, and development of FPGA-based systems for broadcast video and audio applications, focusing on Embedded System hardware and electronic design;
Optimize FPGA designs to enhance video processing, audio synchronization and develop electronic systems with FPGA architectures;
Conduct thorough simulation, testing, debugging, and verification of FPGA designs to ensure seamless functionality and adherence to industry standards;
Maintain and improve FPGA build processes using CI/CD tools like Jenkins;
Estimate work effort to establish schedules for design delivery;
Stay updated on industry trends, emerging standards, and technologies related to broadcast video and audio.Who you are
Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related technical field;
Two (2) to five (5) years experience in FPGA design and development with strong focus on electronic and PCB design;
Proficiency in FPGA design, power estimation, implementation, optimization, testing, and development using hardware description languages (HDL) such as VHDL or Verilog;
Ability to simulate and verify FPGA designs using tools like Questa;
Familiarity with FPGA development tools such as Xilinx Vivado, or Altera Quartus;
Proficiency in debugging and troubleshooting FPGA designs, including using logic analyzers and other debugging tools;
Ability to create clear and concise documentation for FPGA designs, including design specifications;
Experience with embedded system integration and real-time operating systems running on inhouse designed hardware;
Experience in high-speed digital design, data serialization, media streaming (ST2110) and transmission protocols within the broadcast industry, particularly HD-SDI video;
Experience with high-speed serial interfaces like PCIe, DDR, Ethernet, and USB;
Knowledge of communication protocols such as SPI, I2 C, UART, and CAN;
Strong understanding of digital logic design principles and ability to create complex digital circuits;
Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python and programming languages C/C++ for FPGA programming and automation;
Understanding TCP/IP from network programming perspective;
Experience in managing code with version control systems like Git to track releases and collaborate with a team through branching and merging;
Strong teamwork and communication skills to collaborate effectively with cross-functional multi-site teams, including hardware engineers, QA engineers, and project managers;
Proven experience in hardware design and development, preferably in a similar role;
Experience with hardware debug and tests;
Strong knowledge of analog and digital electronics, microcontrollers, and FPGA;
Familiarity with industry standards, regulations, and compliance related to hardware design;
Proficiency in schematic capture and oversight of PCB layout;
Fluency in English, both oral and written.Working Conditions
Competitive Compensation packages
Energizing and supportive work environment
Remote work

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work involved for this job. It is not an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of this job.
Grass Valley is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to gender, marital status, race, religion, colour, age, disability, sexual orientation or protected veteran status.
_______________________________________________________________OportunidadeOs Engenheiros FPGA da Grass Valley desenvolvem soluções de ponta para criação, transmissão e distribuição de conteúdo. Suas responsabilidades incluirão liderar o design de arquitetura FPGA, design eletrônico e de PCB, além de colaborar com equipes multifuncionais para integrar essas soluções aos nossos sistemas de transmissão.Função
Liderar a arquitetura, design e desenvolvimento de sistemas baseados em FPGA para aplicações de vídeo e áudio broadcast, com foco em hardware de sistemas embarcados e design eletrônico;
Otimizar designs FPGA para aprimorar o processamento de vídeo, sincronização de áudio e desenvolver sistemas eletrônicos com arquiteturas FPGA;

Graduado em Engenharia Elétrica, Engenharia da Computação ou área técnica relacionada;
De 2 a 5 anos de experiência em design e desenvolvimento FPGA com forte foco em design eletrônico e de PCB;
Proficiência em design FPGA, estimativa de consumo, implementação, otimização, testes e desenvolvimento usando linguagens de descrição de hardware (HDL) como VHDL ou Verilog;
Capacidade de simular e verificar designs FPGA usando ferramentas como Questa;
Familiaridade com ferramentas de desenvolvimento FPGA como Xilinx Vivado ou Altera Quartus;

description:

Ensino superior em Administração, Engenharia, Logística, Gestão de Riscos ou áreas correlatas;

Experiência em torre de controle, monitoramento dos caminhões, chegada, saída, ocorrências;
Experiência em acionar seguro, acompanhar sinistro junto à seguradora, reportar as ocorrências e soluções ao corpo diretivo da empresa.
Conhecimento das normas de segurança e legislação vigente;
Habilidade para liderar equipes multidisciplinares;
Excelentes capacidades de comunicação, organização e tomada de decisão;
Excel avançado.
Conhecimentos de Power BI;
Conhecimentos de conceitos Kaizen;
Conhecimentos de bancos de dados e estatística;RESPONSABILIDADES:
Desenvolver, implementar e monitorar políticas e procedimentos de gerenciamento de riscos;
Identificar, avaliar e propor soluções para mitigar riscos operacionais, financeiros e regulatórios;
Realizar auditorias internas e análises de conformidade;
Treinar equipes sobre práticas de segurança e prevenção de riscos;
Elaborar relatórios periódicos para a diretoria e demais áreas envolvidas;
Atuar diretamente na gestão de crises e incidentes, propondo planos de ação eficazes.
Desenvolver e orientar a confecção de relatórios estatísticos de avarias e sinistros, através do levantamento das informações, visando fornecer subsídios para tomada de decisão; negociar com clientes, terceiros e seguradoras, os valores de indenização a serem pagos ou reembolsados, decorrentes dos danos ocorridos nas cargas;
Atender à fiscalização de órgãos públicos, dirimindo dúvidas, negociando pendências e esclarecendo procedimentos com o objetivo de atender às necessidades legais;

Compatível com o mercado; Pacote de Benefícios completo!

title: Director of salesforce implementation
description:
Position OverviewThe Director of Salesforce Implementation will lead a team of up to 15 Salesforce professionals across the US and LATAM, including consultants, developers, administrators, solution architects, and marketing automation specialists (MCAE and MCE). This role is responsible for project delivery excellence, ensuring projects are scoped accurately, executed effectively, delivered on time, and aligned with client expectations and IMG quality standards. The ideal candidate combines deep Salesforce expertise with proven team leadership, project governance, delivery operations, and client relationship skills. This director will serve as the operational leader of the implementation team, optimizing processes, reviewing time and utilization, providing coaching, managing escalations, and driving exceptional customer satisfaction.Key ResponsibilitiesTeam Leadership and Management
Lead and mentor a cross-functional Salesforce implementation team across US and LATAM.
Provide coaching, one-on-ones, growth planning, and performance management.
Promote a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and high-quality delivery.
Manage staffing, capacity planning, and resource allocation across all active projects.Project and Delivery Oversight
Oversee all Salesforce implementation projects including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud Account Engagement (MCAE), Marketing Cloud Engagement (MCE), and integrations.
Conduct regular project reviews to ensure progress, scope alignment, and adherence to timelines.
Monitor time tracking, utilization, and project budgets; identify trends and address over-burn or under-delivery risks.
Establish and refine delivery processes, best practices, and standard operating procedures.Quality Control and Customer Satisfaction
Ensure projects meet IMG quality standards and deliver measurable business value.
Provide strategic oversight and intervention on escalations or complex project challenges.
Maintain high levels of customer satisfaction through proactive communication and alignment.
Partner with the Sales team during handoff to ensure a smooth transition from scoping to delivery.Operational Excellence
Develop and maintain predictable implementation workflows and project governance frameworks.
Improve reporting and tracking across project health, timelines, scope changes, and team utilization.
Implement delivery tools, templates, documentation standards, and internal QA processes.
Collaborate with leadership on forecasting, hiring needs, and Salesforce practice growth.Cross-Department Collaboration
Work closely with the Sales, Customer Success, and Operations teams to ensure alignment across the client lifecycle.
Participate in internal strategic planning, service-offering refinement, and productization of Salesforce packages such as Jumpstart.
Support revenue growth by identifying upsell and cross-sell opportunities during implementation.QualificationsRequired
7 or more years of Salesforce implementation experience (consulting or client-side).
3 or more years leading technical or consulting teams, preferably remote or geographically distributed.
Strong knowledge of Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and marketing automation platforms (MCAE and MCE).
Proven ability to manage multiple simultaneous projects and large-scale client engagements.
Experience with resource planning, time tracking, utilization reporting, and delivery KPIs.
Strong communication, leadership, and conflict resolution skills.
Ability to operate at both the strategic and tactical levels.Preferred
Salesforce certifications.
Experience at a Salesforce partner agency or professional services organization.
Background with project management tools such as Asana, Monday, or Wrike.
Experience with US, LATAM, and offshore team management.What We Offer
Competitive salary and performance bonus structure.
Flexible remote work environment.
Opportunity to lead a rapidly expanding Salesforce practice.
Supportive leadership and a culture focused on growth, innovation, and client success.
Professional development opportunities and Salesforce certification support.
Paid time off, paid holidays, and emphasis on work-life balance.

title: Design Director, Ui/Ux & Brand
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Matter , a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos) . Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the Role

We are hiring a Design Director - a visionary leader with a strong design background who thrives in driving high-quality design execution across various platforms as well as managing creative talent. You’ll combine strategic oversight with hands‑on involvement, ensuring that every design project meets the highest standards of excellence.

This role requires deep experience in branded UI/UX design. You’re a senior‑level design lead that can independently own multiple web design engagements simultaneously. Navigating client feedback and pushback is an everyday muscle you successfully work with. You can show deep experience in being able to thread the needle between game‑changing UI, conversion‑oriented UX, and technical feasibility, all on a tight timeline. Clients are consistently impressed by your knowledge of e‑commerce heuristics and how you combine that with unique and branded design. You love working with developers to understand how to make your ideas come to life and sell clients on design solutions and tradeoffs they have to make to complete engagements on‑time.

You pride yourself on being able to effortlessly spin up a new brand design system for a client that feels differentiated, elevated, and informed by your strategic market analysis. You have consistently merged business thinking with exceptional visual craft into scalable brand identities that work across paid media, retention, web, social, and packaging.

In addition to your individual contributor responsibilities, you will report to the Director of Creative and play a key role in guiding a talented team of designers, overseeing the delivery of exceptional designs for paid ads, emails, landing pages, and e‑commerce web design. With your deep expertise in UI/UX and brand design, you’ll empower your team to elevate their skills while maintaining a high bar for creative output and attention to detail.

This role requires a balance of creativity, business strategy, and leadership in a fast‑paced, collaborative environment. You’ll work closely with marketing, product, and development teams to ensure the alignment of design goals with broader business objectives. Your ability to drive creative strategy and manage multiple projects with precision will be essential to your success. Darkroom is a career incubator for ambitious talent looking to operate at the intersection of business, design, and innovation.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English. Open to candidates in the following locations: Brazil, Mexico, Portugal, and Spain.

Senior Individual Contributor Responsibilities:

  • Lead 1‑3 UI/UX engagements as needed, focusing on creating branded e‑commerce websites.

  • Emphasize branded UI, conversion‑focused UX, and clarity in design approaches.

  • Present design work to clients, explaining design choices based on effective reasoning and UX principles.

  • Manage design projects independently from discovery to hand‑off, adhering to timelines and collaborating with developers to ensure feasibility.

  • Develop component systems and maintain design guidelines for consistency.

Management Responsibilities:

  • Manage a team of designers, starting with 2‑4 direct reports and expanding as the team grows. Provide support in strategy, project management, design feedback, performance evaluation, and handling escalations.

  • Conduct weekly 1:1s with direct reports to assess client health, offer feedback, and oversee career development.

  • Ensure high‑quality work output from direct reports, focusing on visual craft, UX expertise, and meeting deadlines.

  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams, including marketers, strategists, developers, and clients, to develop project plans, understand business objectives, and address client issues.

  • Refine internal processes for client work in coordination with the Director of Creative. Provide training and feedback to enhance the skills of the design team.

You Should Apply if this Sounds Like You:

  • 3‑6+ years of senior‑level web design experience with e‑commerce companies, with at least 1 year of people management experience preferred. Must have experience in responsive web design.

  • Digital portfolio showcasing web design and branding skills, including color theory, hierarchy, composition, and typography.

  • Self‑motivated, proactive, and detail‑oriented with a strong sense of ownership.

  • Experience collaborating with developers and documenting designs for development hand‑off.

  • Comfortable with client‑facing responsibilities in English, including leading discovery calls and resolving client feedback.

  • Capable of providing constructive internal feedback and guiding direct reports to improve their work.

  • Ability to tackle ambiguous problems, understand business challenges, design solutions, and execute them effectively.

  • Proficiency in Figma, including features like Auto Layout, Components, and Variants, is essential.

  • Experience with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator) is required.

  • Bonus: Familiarity with HTML/CSS or frameworks like Tailwind.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world‑class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote‑first culture with a strong community base. While many roles remain fully remote , employees hired to work from our New York or Lisbon HQs (opening early 2026) are expected to adopt a hybrid working model , including weekly in‑office appearances . Hub locations also include the Bay Area, Philly, São Paulo, and Barcelona.

  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work‑life balance.

  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross‑functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

title: Head Of Brand, Marketing And Promotion
description:
Job Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”), which for the first time ever is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Department: Commercial & Marketing

Location: Brazil

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Position Overview

The Head of Brand & Marketing at FWWC27 LTDA, which is FIFA’s Brazilian subsidiary responsible for the delivery of FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Brazil (TM), will be tasked to guide and implement brand and marketing plans, campaigns and activations in line with the marketing & communication strategy. This role is critical to the success of the first ever FIFA Women’s World Cup to be held in South America with a vision to unite the world through an unprecedented experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Key Responsibilities
  • Act as an extension to, and be part of the global MBBI (Marketing, Brand, Business Intelligence) team based in Zurich with dual reporting lines, for being a key representative to all Brand, Marketing and Promotion Tournament matters.
  • Responsible for all promotional aspects including any communications designed and required to support the commercial and marketing objectives of the tournament.
  • Be the main liaison for Host Country and Host City representatives, tournament executive leadership representing the MBBI team.
  • Lead the local, regional and national delivery of various marketing campaigns and initiatives related to, and beyond identified tournament milestones.
  • Lead a team of brand & marketing professionals on the ground, and ensure seamless cooperation, collaboration and integration with all relevant functional areas at FWWC27 LTDA and FIFA’s head office in Zurich, as well as any other functional areas such as legal, finance, etc.
  • Identify and communicate opportunities to create dedicated local, regional or national promotional activities that support the objectives of the tournament, the marketing strategy, or any relevant stakeholders such as commercial partners, media partners, host cities, and others.
  • Identify and drive commercial value through the marketing of the tournament’s brand assets and intellectual property, including but not limited to mascots, licensing & retail, the FIFA Fan Festival, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Trophy Tour, official music tracks/album/sonic identities, and other.
  • Contribute to, and drive implementation of ticketing & hospitality go-to-market strategy and activations plans.
  • Establish and maintain strong and impactful relationships with relevant partners, celebrities, influencers, key event organizers, agencies, etc.
  • Manage and maintain budget and liaise with the relevant colleagues in Zurich in all matters budget and spend.
  • Oversee the correct implementation and utilization of all in-market tournament brand asset implementations and applications including, but not limited to, event and stadium dressing, experiential marketing applications, retail branding, and any other use of the brand assets by FIFA’s internal and external stakeholders.
  • Manage procurement and legal processes (in compliance with FWWC27 LTDA policies and guidelines) as it relates to the tendering and contracting of local, regional or national suppliers, service providers, agencies, and other.
  • Manage and deliver all necessary reporting measures related to the tournament.
  • Drive and manage effective communications between the relevant functional areas and, in particular with the MBBI team in Zurich.
Your Profile
  • Bachelor’s degree or similar higher education in marketing, or a marketing related discipline.
  • Minimum 10 years’ experience in a relevant leadership position.
  • Proven experience delivering major brand & marketing plans.
  • Experience in the sports and/or entertainment industry is a major plus.
  • Experience working in a global or international environment.
  • Proven track record in managing a team in a matrix or similar structure.
  • Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills and the ability to manage up, down and sideways.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills.
  • Profound knowledge of Brazilian and South American markets and culture.
  • Ability to work to deadlines and stress resilient.
  • Financial and budget management.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written).
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.
Additional Information
  • Seniority level: Mid-Senior level
  • Employment type: Contract
  • Job function: Marketing and Sales

Referrals increase your chances of interviewing at FIFA Women’s World Cup™ by 2x.
